11.name: rustplan_inv
11.prompt:
Architecture slice (READ-ONLY; xhigh). Design Castor v1.0.0 in Rust. You have the repo inventory in context. Apply these research verdicts:

- Stack: rmcp 3.5 (stdio, #[tool] macros→schemars), tokio, axum (:18021 long-poll), serde, tracing-as-JSONL-telemetry (collapse event log+telemetry), clap CLI, native ast-grep crate, readability+html2md.
- Cutover: main→branch node-castor; main = clean Rust tree; v1.0.0. No fallbacks, no dual runtime.
- Skills: adopt agentskills.io SKILL.md; model-routed: skill index in system prompt (~100 tok/skill), body loaded by model via read_file; ~300 LOC; decide optional keyword fast-path.
- Evo: re-architect offline (AVO/GEPA): lineage DAG + reflective offline batch optimizer + apply-at-session-start + events.jsonl telemetry + watchdog (~600-800 LOC); no live in-harness loop. Prerequisite: NEW small eval set (10-30 replayable tasks, pass/fail scorer) — do NOT rerun the full swe-rebench pipeline.
- Search: SearXNG primary self-hosted in WSL2 as systemd service (uv venv, limiter:false → no Valkey; delete Docker mgr); Brave optional-key fallback; DDG last resort; Context7 separate doc path; drop Tavily. v1.0.0 = health-check + actionable error only.
- Extensions: per-dispatch rmcp TokioChildProcess bridges; freeze tool set at dispatch start; tool schemas LAST in prompt (vLLM APC hash-chain invalidation); playwright+context7 recommended, github optional; ~370 LOC; ~20KB result cap.
- Distribution: Biome pattern (root pkg + @castor/{win32-x64,linux-x64,linux-arm64,darwin-arm64} exact-pinned optionalDeps, 30-line shim, provenance:true, plain GHA matrix). OPEN: also ship win32-x64 .exe (SmartScreen/Smart-App-Control hard-block risk, cline#12934) vs pure-JS shim→wsl.exe→linux binary (no Windows exe, WSL mandatory). Resolve using current topology facts: who consumes :18020/:18022, where the injected proxy must live, whether the MCP server process runs on Windows or in WSL today (check config/index.js/stream_proxy spawn path + multi-instance sharing by Antigravity×2+Claude Code).

Deliver:
1) Cargo workspace layout + module tree with per-module LOC budget (target ~4.5-5.5K total incl. evo offline + skills).
2) Concurrency/process model: seats=2, locks, multi-instance sharing, stream-proxy placement (internal tokio task in whichever process owns engine lifecycle vs spawned child) — recommend one.
3) Resolved open decisions with rationale (distribution variant, proxy, searxng cmd, skills fast-path).
4) Milestone plan: each milestone = one Qwen session, with objective acceptance gates (e.g. 'cargo test N suites green; parity checklist X passes').
5) Test mapping: the 67 JS suites → Rust test modules (port / collapse / delete), incl. the 137-vector security suite as ported policy vectors.
6) Top risks + mitigations (rmcp 3.x pinning+live-server tests, WSL interop spike, Windows spawn semantics).
7) Parity-improvement list (what v1.0.0 does better than JS Castor).
Challenge weak spots. Minimal LOC. Synthesis with coordinates.

21.name: castor_m1
21.prompt:
Implementation slice M1c: replace castor/src/state/mod.rs stub with state-dir layout + lockfile primitive (single concern; config.rs stays as-is).

Spec:
- `StateDir::new(config)` resolves ~/.castor (honor config.state_dir) and provides typed paths: tasks/, tasks/slots/, sessions/, telemetry/, locks/, evo/. `ensure()` creates dirs on demand.
- Lockfile primitive (port the JS lifecycle-locks semantics exactly):
  - `acquire(name, ttl)`: O_EXCL create at locks/<name>.lock, content = {pid, held_at, ttl}. Success = exclusive. On existing file: if fresh (age < ttl) → reject with heldBy info; if stale → rename to <name>.lock.tombstone (atomic, fails if raced) then O_EXCL create fresh.
  - `release(name)`: read lock; if content.pid != current pid → refuse (foreign PID never releases, return error); else remove. Tombstones are inert.
  - `WedgeCounter`: atomic increment/read at locks/<name>.count via write-temp-then-rename.
- pid for "current process": std::process::id() — fine for both Windows-dev and WSL-target semantics at this stage.
- Unit tests (hermetic: state_dir pointed at tempdir): fresh acquire; in-TTL reject carries heldBy pid; stale reclaim via tombstone (simulated by backdating held_at); tombstone race loser fails cleanly; foreign-PID release refused; owner release works and allows re-acquire; wedge counter increments atomically under concurrent tasks (spawn a few tokio tasks).
- Gate: cargo build && cargo test green in WSL (/mnt/d/LLM_Ecosystem/castor). Report test count.

32.name: castor_m3a
32.prompt:
Slice M3a: castor/src/task/registry.rs + task/semaphore.rs. Port semantics from mcp-castor/src/task_registry.js + src/semaphore.js (read once, extract semantics, write once). Code-first; compiler is reference; NO probe scripts. Existing helpers: config.rs, state/mod.rs (StateDir, Locks, WedgeCounter).

REGISTRY: TaskRecord{id,status queued|executing|completed|failed|cancelled(+reason),prompt,cwd,session_id,pid,heartbeat,turns_budget,created/started/ended}. In-memory map behind tokio::Mutex; disk mirror <state>/tasks/task_<id>.json via write-temp-rename on each transition. API: create/get/list/update/transition. Orphan: executing + dead pid -> transition failed 'orphaned worker died'. Terminal-event idempotence: exactly one terminal transition ever (orphan_terminal_event anchor). extend_budget(id, n): fail-fast on missing/terminal, clamp at MAX_ELASTIC_TURNS=200 (lease_extension anchor).

SEMAPHORE: file-lease slots <state>/tasks/slots/slot_N.json, N = config.max_concurrent_tasks (default 1). acquire(task_id,tenant) async FIFO queue when full; release frees; alien tenant blocked while another tenant holds ANY slot; stale-lease reclaim via dead pid; zero leftover leases post-release.

TESTS: cross-process slot exclusion (spawn child process holding slot, parent blocks then acquires after release); alien-tenant block/unblock; FIFO order; orphan mark on dead pid; terminal exactly-once; extend clamps + fail-fast.
Gate: cargo test green in WSL (/mnt/d/LLM_Ecosystem/castor). Report count.

35.name: castor_m3b
35.prompt:
Slice M3b: castor/src/task/wait.rs — axum status/long-poll server on config.ports.status (18021), completing task/. Code-first; compiler is reference; port anchors: mcp-castor/tests/wait_endpoint.test.js + status_lifecycle.test.js.

API:
- GET /task/:id/wait?timeout_s=N — long-poll; wakes on terminal transition (tokio::sync::broadcast or watch per task). Terminal => ALWAYS HTTP 200 JSON {id,status,reason,...} whether success OR failure — never mask status; Connection: close header; timeout => 200 with {status:'executing',timed_out:true}; unknown id => 404 (wait_endpoint anchor).
- GET /task/:id/status — computed elapsed_s (queued AND executing), never 500 on malformed disk file => 400 {error} (status_lifecycle anchor).
- Serves memory+disk: waiters on tasks owned by OTHER instances resolve by polling the disk mirror (fallback poll loop, 500ms) so any instance's tasks are waitable.

SINGLETON: acquire Locks::acquire('status') at startup; lock held => exit 0 with one stderr line 'status server already running' (multi-instance: first wins, others skip). main.rs: `status` subcommand runs it; `mcp` subcommand spawns it as detached child (proxy.lock pattern: lock -> probe health -> spawn if down -> release) best-effort, never blocks serving.

TESTS: spawn server on ephemeral port (inject port via test config); wait wakes on completed transition; wait wakes on failed transition with honest status; timeout path; 404; malformed task file => 400; orphan reaper runs before reads (dead pid => failed, idempotent).
Gate: cargo test green in WSL. Report count.

56.name: castor_m7a
56.prompt:

95.name: castor_m10_opt
95.prompt:
ONE file: castor/src/evo/optimizer.rs — the offline reflective optimizer. References (read once each): mcp-castor/src/harness/evo/evaluator.js + evo_operator.js (port their mechanics; the live in-loop tool quartet is DELETED by design), castor/src/evo/lineage.rs (the DAG it appends to), castor/src/evals/runner.rs (run_task = the fitness scorer).

Contract: `Optimizer::run(evals_dir, lineage_path, opts) -> Vec<CommitRecord>` — one GEPA-style reflective batch: for each eval task, run_task(Golden) → baseline fitness; operator proposes a variation of the artifact (the prompt/system-text artifact in the lineage head, concrete edit proposals as text); for each variation, run_task again → fitness; append scored nodes to Lineage (parents = current head, AVO greedy: keep best). No live loop, no in-flight mutation — this is a batch command over recorded traces. Errors typed; eval ERROR ≠ fitness 0.

Tests: temp evals dir with a fabricated task (reuse the runner's fixture helpers) + temp lineage → run() appends baseline node + variation nodes, best_parent returns the fitter; all-tasks-ERROR → no nodes appended, typed report; deterministic (same inputs → same nodes modulo timestamps). `pub mod optimizer;` in evo/mod.rs. Do NOT wire the CLI (`castor evo` is the next slice).

GATE: `wsl.exe -e bash -lc 'cd /mnt/d/LLM_Ecosystem/castor && cargo build && cargo test'` green; report test count.
